viewerQuestion: Same price, different parts. What does this comparison page actually settle?
viewerTakeaway: I committed to an answer, then found out the page could not settle it, so I know to decide on something else.

requiredCapabilities.description: Existing deterministic static Compare UI capture.

beats.narration: Two part lists, one comparison page. Before you read the bars, say out loud which side you expect to come out ahead.

At SpecSmith's editorial catalog prices the two CPU-and-GPU pairs on this comparison come to the same parts subtotal. That is an editorial CPU-and-GPU parts subtotal, not a complete build and not a live retail price.
On this comparison every per-game difference is smaller than the range SpecSmith's model declares for its own estimates, so the model does not separate them on frame rate. These are model estimates.
beats.onScreenText: The differences sit inside the model's own range

beats.narration: So whichever side you picked, this page did not settle it. That is a real result, not a missing feature.
Open the comparison and read the bars for the games you actually play.
